evidence.detail: public() returns True for admin/demimod unconditionally when is_in_current_run, so admins see the full deck without any indication the deck is normally hidden
{{#public}} block shows decklist with no note; only {{^public}} block explains the deck is hidden — admins never see that message

triage.fix_sketch:
In decksite/views/deck.py, add a method admin_only_visible() returning self.is_in_current_run and bool(session.get('admin') or session.get('demimod')). In decksite/templates/deck.mustache, inside the {{#public}} block add {{#admin_only_visible}}

This deck is in an active league run and is only visible to you because you are an admin or demimod.

{{/admin_only_visible}}. Total change ~8 lines.
triage.notes: Purely additive display change; no data or logic is altered. The existing 'section class="admin demimod"' CSS pattern already hides such notes from regular users.
